patthana3.14:153.1: saraṇaṃ anidassana appaṭighañca araṇaṃ anidassana appaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo anidassana appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.14:154.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, avigate pañca, (sahajātavāraṃpi
patthana3.14:156.1: saraṇo anidassana appaṭigho dhammo saraṇassa anidassana appaṭighassa dhammassa hetu paccayena paccayo, tīṇi. saraṇo anidassana appaṭigho dhammo araṇassa anidassana appaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana3.14:157.1: hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe cattāri, avigate satta,
patthana3.14:158.1: na hetuyā satta, na ārammaṇe satta.
patthana3.14:160.1: ārammaṇe cattāri, na hetupaccayā ārammaṇe cattāri,
patthana3.14:161.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomaṃpi paccaniyaṃpi anulomapaccaniyaṃpi paccaniyānulomaṃpi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.) piṭṭhi kusala dukatikaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. dukatika paṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
